storage: one gzipped JSONL per composite key <monthStartDate>__<tierIdentifier> under <archive>/finramonthly/ (gz-on-write); partition-level dedup per (month, tier)
written_by: server/finraQuery.ts refreshFinraAts (6h poll, newest 2 monthStartDate values × 2 tiers NMS/OTCE; no backfill built)
source: FINRA Query API monthlySummary (api.finra.org, keyless; contract live-verified 2026-07-08). Composite-key partitions [monthStartDate, tierIdentifier]. Monthly per-firm and per-symbol OTC volume (no ATS/OTC venue split at this cadence — tiers are NMS/OTCE, unlike weeklySummary's ATS_/OTC_ prefix split), published ~T+1 month. Fetched with the raised page cap (ATS_MAX_PAGES=50) shared with weeklySummary.
license: FINRA data, free with attribution; redistribution/resale of raw data needs FINRA license review before monetization

field_map.summaryTypeCode: granularity flag — OTC_M_SMBL_FIRM (per symbol per firm), OTC_M_SMBL (per symbol, all firms), OTC_M_FIRM (per firm, all symbols). Only OTC_M_SMBL rows are ranked (server-side) — mixing granularities double-counts volume.
field_map.issueSymbolIdentifier/issueName: populated on *_SMBL(_FIRM) rows only; null on *_FIRM rows

confidence_model: RAW official monthly OTC volume as disseminated by FINRA. No signal claim — gate 1 DATA only.
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04). Census build #4 part 2 of 2 (wishlist.md DATACORE MAXIMUS FINRA PART 2 DESIGN NOTES) — the monthlySummary leg.
